rationale: The assistant correctly identified 4C as a water-supply error, asked sensible first checks, and the customer fixed it by opening the isolation valve, matching the hidden truth. However, when told the valve slot was at 90 degrees to the pipe, it hedged ('might be closed or only half-open') and simultaneously declared it 'very likely' that debris had blocked the inlet filter, asking the customer to unscrew the hose before the simpler valve check was confirmed. The closing message also speculated the valve was 'slightly closed or partially obstructed by debris' despite no filter check having been done, a mild unsupported embellishment. Safety advice (unplug, turn off water before handling the hose) was appropriate and no parts or escalation were pushed.
